title: The Paymaster's Box
summary: Osric Hale says the Redhand's paymaster kept the robed strangers' coin in Wickham Keep's strongroom, in two boxes, because he trusted nobody, himself included. Osric wants to see whose seal is on the purses.

steps.journal: Open two chests anywhere in Wickham Keep, on any floor. The paymaster's strongroom, off the Barracks on the second floor, holds two.

ready: The paymaster's boxes are open. Take a purse to Osric Hale at the Watch post by Thornwick's well.
done: The paymaster's boxes in the Keep's strongroom: coal-red wax on every purse, no crest. Osric sent a seal to Sister Ilse.
